svg.title: Material evidence needs its recorded context
svg.desc: A fictional two-layer evidence model, not an Old Kiyyangan excavation profile. Evidence in Layer A and Layer B requires separate recorded context and dating. Neither layer supplies a universal age for every terrace.

g.text: Fictional layer model / Not an actual site profile
Layer A: record location and associations
Ask what evidence dates this deposit or activity.
Layer B: keep its own context
Do not assign its date to every feature in the region.
A date must fit the claim you are making.
No object collection or digging is required.
Compare documented evidence with community knowledge.
